newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia palm olein stable in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia palm olein stable in late trade.

text.p: Indonesian palm olein prices were mostly stable in late trading on Tuesday, with buying interest improving followings gains in Malaysia, traders said.

They said palm olein was quoted at 1,385-90 rupiah/kg in Jakarta, unchanged from the opening, but trades were also heard at 1,380 rupiah. Crude palm oil was done at 1,191 rupiah/kg in the North Sumatran city of Medan at a tender on Monday, compared with the previous tender price of 1,213 rupiah.
"There was some buying following increases in Malaysia," one trader said. "But buying, in general, has been sporadic because of the volatility in the Malaysian market the past few days."
Traders said prices remained under selling pressure as some players were selling below the market range.
"Prices are under pressure, with some players offering at well below the market range," one trader said.

Data from Belawan Port showed that the MT Kosogawa left the North Sumatran port on Monday for Malaysia's Butterworth with 2,100 tonnes of crude palm oil and 750 tonnes of palm fatty acid. The MV Lucija will leave on June 18 for Pasir Gudang in Malaysia with 17,900 tonnes of palm kernal expeller.
The MT Pangeran will leave on Tuesday for Semarang in Central Java with 1,600 tonnes of palm olein. The MT Asia-II left for Cirebon with 2,100 tonnes of palm olein on Monday.
The MT Paseban left for Semarang on Monday with 1,000 tonnes of palm olein. The MT Cakra-I will leave on Wednesday for Tanjung Priok in Jakarta with 2,000 tonnes of palm olein.
